title: Red Hat Security Advisory: Red Hat OpenStack Platform 17.1 (openstack-manila) security update
description: A critical security vulnerability (CVE-2026-71195) has been identified in Red Hat OpenStack Platform 17.1's Manila component. The flaw allows a public Manila share to permit cross-project access-rule and export-metadata writes, potentially compromising multi-tenant file share security. Red Hat has issued a security update to address this issue in the openstack-manila packages for version 17.1. Users are advised to apply the update following Red Hat's guidance.
